detail.title: Desktop Pop-Up Socket - Silver
detail.overview: The Ant Esports AEMDS412 is a pop-up desktop socket that stays hidden flush within a table until needed, popping up at the press of a button to reveal 2 AC outlets, 2 RJ45 network ports, a USB port, an HDMI port, a VGA port and a 3.5mm audio jack. Its solid aluminium construction gives it a premium, durable feel suited to conference rooms, gaming desks, home offices and hotel countertops alike. A spill-proof design with leakage protection keeps it safe even if liquid is accidentally spilled nearby, and simple drill-and-mount installation means it fits into most desks, sofas or TV cabinets without extensive modification. An elegant, space-saving solution for anyone who wants full connectivity without permanent cable clutter.
